about: A deal by a real dealer of the style kameran, lifted out of the live table's film by verktyg/lyft.py into the lens world of data/uppsattning.json (metres: x to the picture's right, y up with the felt at 0, z toward the player). The same fields as our own figure's moves: per frame R and L (the dealer's own right and left) with s shoulder, e elbow, w wrist and p the hand's 21 points in MediaPipe's order (null where the hand was not found), h the head's middle, g the point he looks at (null where the face was not found), card with its middle c, its long side l and its normal n. The card is seen only where it lies on the felt (seen true); before that c is the grip of the hand taken to hold it and l and n are null. One camera gives no depth: the shoulders are put 0.065 m behind the felt's edge (estimated), the arms are held to an upper arm of 0.289 m and a forearm of 0.279 m (SAM 3D Body's median over 67 key frames, with what it lacks on our own figure added), and the hip is assumed. The elbows' and wrists' depth is SAM 3D Body's, read on this computer in key frames (verktyg/sam_runpod.py; README, "Djup ur SAM 3D Body") and drawn straight between them; MediaPipe gives where each joint is seen. The left wrist is not held at the shoe. verktyg/lyft.py prov says how far such a lift lies from the truth on our own figure's film. g is counted from the live table's camera (data/scen.json): the line from the head to it, turned by the head's and the eyes' own turn from how they are in the betting phases, where both dealers mostly look into the camera. blick says where the gaze ends: kameran (within 20 degrees of the line to the camera; in the waits the dealers look 8 to 18 degrees over it, likely at a screen above it), skon, plats <n>, egna korten, bordet or annat; blick_grader is its angle from the line to the camera. a is the face per frame: the shapes our own figure has, by ARKit's names, as MediaPipe's Face Landmarker scores them, 0 to 1 (null where the face was not found); evened over a tenth of a second, the blinks left as they are. Left and right are the dealer's own. It is the expression that is carried, not the face's form. data/stil-*.json, face, says which shapes carry something on a face this small and which are flutter.
djup: SAM 3D Body: armbågarnas och handledernas djup mot axeln i nyckelrutorna (data/sam-prov/livebordet-sam.json), rakt emellan; MediaPipe ger var lederna syns

armar.kalla: skattat: SAM 3D Body, median över 67 nyckelrutor, med det SAM saknar på vår docka lagt till (data/sam-prov/jamforelse.json, benlangder_m.rattelse)

seat_note: seats are 1 to 7 from the picture's left, the dealer's right
hip_note: assumed: 0.47 m under the shoulders' middle; the hips are hidden behind the table
huvud_note: The head's own turn, without the eyes, into the lifted pieces already in lift_dir (nothing else in them changes): per (verktyg/lyft.py huvud): huvud is nod, turn, tilt in degrees from rest, hv the point the head faces, ansikte the face mesh own nod, turn, tilt toward the camera (not from rest, evened lightly).
